title: Copilot Studio: cost controls in the Microsoft 365 admin center
summary: The default, billing model and roadmap facts are supported, and the cited Learn pages opened successfully. The billing-plan creation command omits the parameter that selects the Azure subscription to charge; the environment-linking command alone does not supply that billing target. Several paths stop early, and Microsoft's role and hard-stop descriptions need their qualifications retained.
